guard_prevention_ledger.evidence: Player emits only source/direction/owner-qualified measured prevention after final mitigation; the activation rejects wrong attribution and replays.

owner_resource_conversion.evidence: Owner-scoped resources cap measured amounts, cannot refill after consumption, and emit the one-shot measured value.

missing_parameters.damage_steps: Array[float], one damage coefficient per tick
missing_parameters.finale_damage: float, optional final coefficient after the last tick

missing_parameters.marked_target_anchor: target reference selected at cast time and used as the zone center
missing_parameters.zone_radius: float radius around the retained marked-target anchor
missing_parameters.zone_membership: target filter requiring every shot target to be inside the anchored zone
missing_parameters.anchor_retention: validity and retention policy for the marked-target anchor
missing_parameters.zone_scoped_reacquisition: reacquisition policy constrained to the anchored zone

missing_parameters.spawn_setup: Dictionary describing a generic setup method and activation-owned arguments

missing_parameters.pulse_sequence: Array[Dictionary] of radius, delay, damage, status and force
missing_parameters.target_tier_overrides: Dictionary of class-agnostic normal, elite and boss status/force multipliers

missing_parameters.pulse_sequence: Array[Dictionary] of damage, status and optional knockback per tick
missing_parameters.finale: Dictionary describing the last radius, damage and status pulse

missing_parameters.pulse_sequence: Array[Dictionary] of radius, delay, damage and force
missing_parameters.radius_curve: Array[float], the ordered radii for the spiral

missing_generic_primitives.gap: The host contract exposes only the player origin; aimed casts cannot obtain a stable aim point or direction.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.aim_point(max_range: float) -> Vector2 and aim_direction(max_range: float) -> Vector2, backed by a class-agnostic ultimate_host_aim(max_range) method.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: Activation.targets() always returns nearest targets and cannot select aimed, highest-HP, marked or densest-cluster targets.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.select_targets(center: Vector2, radius: float, limit: int, priority: String, hint: Dictionary = {}) -> Array, with priority limited to generic policies.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: Activation can query only a circle, so corridors, arena lines and ordered pierce hits cannot be resolved.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.targets_in_corridor(start: Vector2, direction: Vector2, length: float, half_width: float, limit: int = 0) -> Array, sorted by projected distance.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: No executor can read the playable arena boundary for edge placement, reflection or ricochet.
No family represents a directed fan, split rays or per-branch pierce.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: Generic trajectory params {fan_count, fan_arc_degrees, split_count, split_arc_degrees, pierce_limit, direction_source} consumed without class or weapon branches.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: The activation ledger caps bosses only; it cannot cap total damage to every target across ricochets, shards or repeated pulses.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.set_per_target_damage_cap(cap_fraction: float, cap_flat: float = 0.0) and have deal_damage() spend that target-local activation budget.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: Current executors have no orbit, outbound-return, reflection, bounce or curved-return motion contract.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: Generic trajectory params {mode, speed, duration, orbit_radius, return_to_origin, bounce_count, curve_degrees} plus activation-owned cleanup.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: A profile selects exactly one family, so a modifier, zone, control pulse, deploy and finale cannot form one activation.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: A generic sequence contract with steps: Array[{at, family, params}], where every family is still resolved by UltimateExecutorLibrary and shares one UltimateActivation ledger.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: There is no deterministic class-agnostic formation for rings, lanes, pentagrams, lattices, seeded fields or safe-path layouts.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.pattern_points(center: Vector2, pattern: String, params: Dictionary) -> PackedVector2Array for generic patterns such as ring, grid, radial, polygon and seeded_annulus.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: Executors cannot store, consume or transfer per-target marks, delayed damage, status stacks, kill-chain state or non-recursion guards.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: Activation-owned record_target_value(), target_value(), consume_target_value() and transfer_target_value() methods plus generic on_hit, on_kill and on_finish triggers.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: Control and status executors apply one configuration to every target and cannot reduce pin, pull, root, stun or execute effects for elites and bosses.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.apply_control(target: Node, status_id: String, config: Dictionary, tier_policy: Dictionary) -> Dictionary.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: Deploys can only set existing properties; they cannot safely configure temporary cap exemptions, intercept/ram roles, priority hunting, fusion/split or restoration of persistent summons.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: A generic ultimate_spawn_setup(config: Dictionary, owner: Node, damage_sink: Callable) scene contract plus activation-owned snapshot/restore for explicitly supplied summon groups.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: No activation API can query, intercept, pull, hide locks from or otherwise affect hostile projectiles.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.projectiles(center: Vector2, radius: float, limit: int = 0) -> Array and apply_projectile_effect(projectile: Node, effect: Dictionary) -> bool.

missing_generic_primitives.gap: No family can execute eligible low-health normal targets while degrading safely to capped damage on stronger tiers.
missing_generic_primitives.proposed_api: UltimateActivation.apply_execute(target: Node, normal_threshold: float, tier_policy: Dictionary, fallback_damage: float) -> UltimateDamageResult.

class_package_delivery_contract.persisted_state_rule: Class packages may declare profiles before FAN-1541, but implementation_state remains declared and targeting/charge/executor/cleanup strategy_id remains unbound; FAN-1541 alone may bind or activate a profile.
class_package_delivery_contract.proof_rule: A class test may inject ready bindings in memory through tests/ultimates/weapon_ultimate_distinctness_helper.gd; it must not activate persisted catalog data.

profiles.evidence: Eight orbiting discs launch radially, return on curves and execute marked low-HP normals.
Targets are marked, the owner becomes briefly untargetable, backstabs run sequentially and stored damage resolves together.
Six anchors form crossing hex edges, apply poison cuts, pull normals and finish with a toxin burst.
A host-following damage zone is sufficient, but its three expanding beats and stronger inward finale are not parameterized.
The axe travels to the aimed arena edge, returns on the same path and consumes an execution mark on catch.
Cardinal lanes, diagonal lanes and the central quake are three ordered geometries rather than one circular burst.
Mycelium propagates through clusters, roots and infects, then deaths create capped non-recursive blooms.
A priority target is sampled on a rail, grants a timed archetype-adaptive bonus and receives capped analysis pulses.
An aimed pod deploy pulls and roots, owns larval projectiles and ends in a hatch burst.
Five charges form a pentagram, crystallize and pull, then explode without recursive kill chains.
An aimed expanding lake dissolves armor and converts measured outcomes into capped permanent charge.
Persistent allies fuse into a temporary tank/caster, then split back without loss or duplication.
Each nearby target gains a mirrored position; paired delayed blasts and one non-recursive reflection kill burst follow.
A screen curse transfers once on death, reduces output and harvests remaining stacks at the finale.
An aimed chain ramps per distinct marked target and collapses every stored node simultaneously.
An aimed dual zone damages outside, restores inside and converts measured damage into capped heal/absorb.
Patient zero spreads timed infection waves and one death transfer under recursion and total-target caps.
A close orbit repeatedly drains measured HP, shreds armor and converts vitality into a temporary shield.
Eight radial beasts then hunt priority targets above the normal summon cap and disappear.
Five seeds grow a connected lattice with safe paths, roots and impales normals, and caps boss control.
A flock marks targets, debuffs them, returns damage wisps to the totem and finishes with a synchronized pulse.
A host-following zone can query every affected target, but four distinct status/control beats and their finale need data-driven steps.
Arena-edge reflected beams rotate through moving intersections with a capped triple hit.
A fair aimed meteor burst executes weak normals and leaves a gravity/fire status zone.
Count, hex placement, lifetime and activation ownership exist; spawned sentries still need a generic setup contract for owner, damage sink and overclock properties.
Twelve drones intercept, ram and repair, then convert measured repair into a final shield pulse.
Seeded smart mines require local chain ownership and an ordered outer-to-inner finale.
Five alternating aimed strips and a crossing final chord apply intersection-only normal stuns.
Four concentric beats pull, slow, launch and knock back with a separate capped center damage budget.
Four cardinal amps link a square feedback field and then overload together.
Three offset ranks charge one aimed corridor with ordered pierce and normal-only pin.
A planted directional wall guards frontally, pushes normals and returns measured prevented damage.
Circular target queries and force application exist, but the growing pull spiral and final outward launch need ordered force parameters.
Three consecration rings culminate in a judgment hit and measured-damage heal/overheal shield.
A mitigation ward stores prevented damage and returns it in one counter burst.
Three different tolls interrupt, chain-smite, heal and grant one lethal-prevention window.
Aimed/highest-HP prey receives bolt waves, four-way neighbour splits and a kill-transferred mark.
An aimed storm corridor receives repeated longitudinal beats that push away from its safe axis.
Current control can damage, displace and apply status; three collapsing rings and tier-scaled immobilize/slow need generic pulse parameters.
An aimed gravity well pulls normals and projectiles, then implodes and emits EMP while bosses resist displacement.
Two opposing walls repeatedly crush targets in an aimed corridor before a release shock.
A host-following accelerating damage field and temporary absorb end in one clearing vent wave.
One aimed/highest-HP shot crosses the arena, pierces in order and spends a strict target budget.

Spotter Scope marks a target-centered kill-zone and must retain that anchor while every planned and re-acquired beam target remains inside the zone; current aimed_sequence searches from the player origin instead.
Five directed paths bounce once at the arena edge, split into three shards and share a cap per target.
Three arena-crossing aimed volleys stop and explode on the first dense groups.
Seven grenades use a seeded aimed formation, shared countdown, outside-in chain and a final burning crater.
Three offset aimed corridor charges pin normals while the stationary owner gains a short frontal guard.
Thirteen unique-target ricochets pay capped gold every third hit and return a jackpot burst to the owner.
Up to eight priority targets receive marks and sequential backstabs; boss wounds escalate under one cap.
A dome grants evasion, taunts through a decoy, suppresses new ranged locks and bursts marked pressure at finish.
